plan.assumptions: relationship periods of Jan and Michael in either order, and the major events involving both of them
plan.graph_sql: SELECT 'relationship' AS source, first_ep / 100 AS season, first_ep % 100 AS episode, type || ', start ' || coalesce(start_ep::text, 'not shown') || ', end ' || coalesce(end_ep::text, 'not shown') AS text, 'major' AS importance, line_ids FROM graph_timeline_now WHERE (a_key ~ '\mjan\M' AND b_key ~ '\mmichael\M') OR (a_key ~ '\mmichael\M' AND b_key ~ '\mjan\M') UNION ALL SELECT 'event', season, episode, text, importance, line_ids FROM graph_events_now WHERE importance = 'major' AND actor_names ILIKE '%jan%' AND actor_names ILIKE '%michael%' ORDER BY season, episode LIMIT 50
